origin: the research side of the measured-claims discipline had authoring, a review dimension, and no walk — this pins document review's unverified-claims sweep at research conclusion: the recorded command re-runs, the value corrects in place, and a conclusion that survives the correction never turns into a question
conduct: The user settled this research last sitting and is back only to wrap it up. Shown where things stand they confirm both threads are done and ask to conclude — they open nothing new and decline any offered exploration. They treat the checkout module count as descriptive: the per-module conclusion holds whatever the number, and the document says so itself. Told during the review brief that the recorded count was re-measured and corrected from four to five, they take the note without ceremony — that is exactly what they expect a document review to do — and they would object to being asked to decide an arithmetic fact. Asked to conclude, they confirm.
